federation.title: Federation trust
federation.invalidSite: Enter a name, valid site UUID, and an HTTPS origin without a path, query, or credentials.
federation.invalidKey: Enter a key ID, public PEM, at least one purpose, and an expiry after the start time.
federation.invalidCertificate: Enter a certificate in PEM format.
federation.saveFailed: Could not save. Check the entries and try again.
federation.loadFailed: Could not load. Refresh to try again.
federation.desktopOnly: View only on mobile. Use a desktop to change federation trust.

impact.suspend: This institution will fail federation trust checks. Renewals for running work may also be affected.
impact.resume: Restore institution trust. Keys, certificates, and business agreements must still be valid.
impact.revokeSite: This cannot be undone. Federation authentication for this institution will be rejected.
impact.revokeKey: This cannot be undone. Messages using this key will fail verification, including historical messages checked again.
impact.revokeCertificate: This cannot be undone. This client certificate will no longer authenticate the institution.

kinds.market-request-receipt: Market task reception and claim receipt

storage.title: Input storage reconciliation
storage.listScope: Showing the oldest {{count}} unknown requests (up to 100); look up other generations directly.
storage.empty: No unknown storage requests to reconcile
storage.stoppedAt: Writers stopped and requests drained at (local)
storage.cleaned: This attempt is cleaned; releasing the import quota still depends on its remaining attempts.
storage.awaitCleanup: Attestation recorded. Actual storage cleanup is still required; recording it does not release quota.
storage.desktopOnly: Read-only on mobile. Record operator attestations on desktop.
storage.boundary: Isolate previous writers, confirm in-flight requests have drained at storage, and retain evidence. Empty listings or timeouts do not prove requests stopped. Quota is released only after actual cleanup succeeds.
storage.ineligible: Not eligible: input cancellation, confirmed execution stop, an expired lease and an unknown request outcome are required. Refresh after the state changes.
storage.allWritersStopped: All original writers are isolated and stopped, and will remain unable to write.
storage.storageRequestsDrained: Storage-side in-flight requests are drained and reliable evidence has been retained.
storage.invalid: Provide a valid incident ID, sha256: followed by 64 hexadecimal digits, and a stop time between lease expiry and now. Both attestations are required.
storage.saveFailed: Recording could not be confirmed. Retry the same statement; if the request changed, close this dialog and refresh to reconcile again.
storage.confirmEffect: This trusts your writer isolation and drain checks, records an audit entry and permits background cleanup. It does not prove storage is already clean.

permissions.title: Federation permissions
permissions.refineSearch: More organizations are available. Refine your search.
permissions.removeEffect: Only this explicit grant is removed; other grants may still include the same capability. Removing a grant does not confirm running tasks are cancelled.
permissions.noGrants: No federation grants in this organization
permissions.desktopOnly: Read-only on mobile. Change federation permissions on desktop.

attestation.recover: Approve historical facts under current institutional authority and retry their separate receipt; does not renew execution authority or change accounts.

settlement.approve: Approve settlements and pre-execution refunds, exchange signatures and retry evidence submission; no payment or credit issuance authority.

adjustment.approve: Approve separate changes to settled charges, exchange signatures and retry evidence; no payment or credit issuance authority.

billing.approve: Approve bills and discounts, attach signatures and retry evidence submission; includes agreement reading, not payment or execution authority.

agreement.read: Read this organization’s agreements and signatures; does not permit approval.
agreement.approve: Sign for this organization, attach counterparty signatures and change local agreement state; includes agreement reading. Platform roles do not automatically grant this authority.

media.logistics: Record this organization’s devices, shipments and handoffs; does not grant export, decryption, import, use or data deletion.
media.export: Approve or revoke dataset delivery to another institution; active data policy must also allow download, redistribution and cross-center replication.
media.import: Approve or revoke media imports into this organization’s selected Agent and managed root; source authorization and data use permissions remain separate.

asset.read: Read federation materials in this organization; local software and data require separate authorization.
asset.map: Register or revoke this organization’s material mappings and signed media inventories; includes reading materials, without granting media import or resource use.

delegation.read: Read this organization’s delegations; does not permit submission or cancellation.
delegation.submit: Submit, read and cancel this organization’s delegations, subject to agreements, budgets and resource authorization.
delegation.cancel: Cancel and read this organization’s delegations; does not permit submission.

result.read: Read delivered results within this organization’s authorized scope; does not permit contract approval.

market.read: View this organization’s market submission, claim and cancellation records.
market.publish: Publish public demands, cancel unclaimed demands and retry those operations for this organization. Includes viewing.
market.claim: Claim public demands and retry claims for this organization. Includes viewing; does not authorize funds or execution.

use.approve: Authorize or revoke a specific dataset version for a partner institution; grants neither file disclosure nor the recipient’s local access.

payment.approve: Confirm external payment facts and corrections, exchange signatures and retry evidence; includes agreement reading, not bank transfers or credit issuance.

case.publish: Independently approve or revoke durable private-ledger storage of this institution’s case evidence. Grants no disclosure, arbitration or financial authority.

disclosure.approve: Approve or revoke this institution’s evidence disclosure policies, including contract viewing. Does not grant arbitration, billing, settlement or payment authority.
disclosure.receive: Register local evidence cases and receive or read fields approved by both institutions. Does not authorize source disclosure, arbitration or financial actions.

dispute.resolve: Approve this institution’s bilateral reconciliation and retry its exchange or chain receipt; financial approvals remain separate.
dispute.read: View this institution’s cases and progress. Does not include contract contents or arbitration authority.
dispute.open: Open cases on this institution’s original records and stop new financial approvals for the task. Includes case viewing, without award or accounting authority.

arbitration.read: Read current bilateral authority for registered cases. Grants no contract, evidence, award or financial access.
arbitration.approve: Approve or revoke arbitration policies, including contract viewing. Grants no award, admission, debit or payment authority.
arbitration.decide: Sign this site’s arbitration decisions. New decisions also require context and evidence access; this grants no debit or unfreeze authority.
arbitration.execute: Execute a received no-financial-change award after rechecking the original preauthorization and current freeze. Does not authorize settlement, adjustment or payment.

effects.cluster.use: Use clusters opened by administrators, and view or cancel your own tasks.
effects.cluster.manage: Manage remote clusters, execution mappings and member access; the management page also requires platform administration permission.

agreements.title: Federation Collaboration
agreements.noPermission: You have no agreement viewing grant in this institution.
agreements.notConfigured: Federation signing identity is not configured on this site.
agreements.desktopOnly: Read-only on mobile. Sign or change agreements on desktop.
agreements.invalidTerms: Terms do not match the protocol: {{fields}}
agreements.wrongSite: This site is not a party to this agreement.
agreements.readFailed: Could not read the file. Select it again.
agreements.unsupportedMode: Ledger coordination is not available. Signing is blocked; the mode will not be changed automatically.
agreements.expired: This agreement has expired and cannot be signed.
agreements.resourceValues: {{cpus}} CPU cores · {{memoryMb}} MB memory · {{gpus}} GPUs · {{wallTimeSec}} seconds
agreements.noTargets: No execution resources specified; receiver-local resource policy still applies.
agreements.accountSearch: Search execution account names or emails
agreements.copyFailed: Could not copy. Expand the signature to copy it manually.
agreements.saveFailed: The operation could not be confirmed. Your entries are retained; check permissions, trust and agreement state before retrying.

modeEffects.bilateral_direct: Delegate after both parties sign and local authorization checks pass. No blockchain dependency.
modeEffects.bilateral_attested: Execute under the bilateral agreement and record evidence asynchronously. Ledger outages do not block cooperation.
modeEffects.ledger_coordinated: Tasks require ledger claims and allowance locks. This interface does not support this mode yet.

effects.sign: Sign the reviewed terms using this institution’s signing key. The revision is immutable; execution still requires both signatures, valid trust and local resource authorization.
effects.attach: Verify the counterparty identity and matching terms. The receiver installs the agreed allowance after verification.
effects.active: Enable this local agreement. Both signatures, validity, trust and resource policies must still pass checks.
effects.suspended: Suspend local agreement authorization. This does not confirm remote or running tasks have stopped.
effects.revoked: Permanently revoke this local agreement. This cannot be undone and does not confirm remote or running tasks have stopped.
effects.exchange: Retry exchange of the original approved signatures after resolving the issue. This does not sign new terms or bypass local execution permission.

exchange.title: Signature exchange
exchange.unavailable: Signature exchange is unavailable on this server.
exchange.disabled: Institution communication is not configured. Historical status remains available.

errors.trust: Check the institution certificate and signing-key trust.
errors.agreement: Check that the agreement is active and has not expired.
errors.permission: Check institution permissions and the restricted execution account.
errors.conflict: The agreement or original signature does not match. Check the original terms.
errors.invalid: The received signature or response is invalid. Check the counterparty configuration.
errors.connection: Exchange has not completed. Check institution connectivity and trust configuration.

backlog.title: Outstanding tasks and evidence
backlog.scope: Unsettled execution attempts or attempts with uncommitted evidence, counted once each.
backlog.unconfigured: No attestation backlog limits in this agreement

commercial.title: Commercial contracts
commercial.noBaseAgreement: No active execution agreements. Import a complete contract to continue.
commercial.futureDate: The contract creation time is in the future. Check the imported contract.
commercial.noExecution: Signing and ledger records do not authorize execution, confirm a bill or make a payment.
commercial.retryEffect: Retry the same signed record and retain its history. An uncertain transaction resumes with its original ID.
commercial.exportFailed: Could not export the contract. Try again.
commercial.notConfigured: Ledger submission is not configured. Pending records are retained.
commercial.checkConfiguration: Check institutional trust and adapter configuration before retrying.

errors.LEDGER_PENDING: The ledger outcome has not been confirmed.
errors.UNTRUSTED_IDENTITY: Institutional signing trust is not valid.
errors.POLICY_DENIED: The institutional policy rejected this submission.
errors.LEDGER_INVALID: The ledger marked this transaction invalid.

usage.title: Usage reports
usage.assertion: Compute Center usage assertions. Bills are not confirmed.
usage.customMeterNotice: Custom meters remain in the contract. Automatic reports currently support only the three standard meters listed.
usage.invalidCorrection: Enter a reason, complete integer quantities and sha256: followed by 64 hexadecimal characters.
usage.syncDisabled: Institution transport is not configured. Saved reports remain available.
usage.correctionNotice: The original report stays intact. This signs a compute center technical assertion; it does not confirm a bill or initiate payment. Your institution must verify and retain the supporting material.
usage.retryNotice: Recheck the existing record. Saved reports, accounting and signatures remain intact.
usage.actionFailed: The action is unconfirmed. Retry the same request; if someone else corrected the report, refresh and review the latest record.
usage.exportFailed: Could not export the report. Try again.

billing.title: Bills
billing.rounding: Amounts in {{unit}}, rounded up per line
billing.draftFailed: Draft unavailable. Check the report ID, terminal task and latest usage report.
billing.invalidBill: Invalid bill or contract mismatch. Import the complete bill for this contract.
billing.approvalBoundary: Confirmation records the amount due. It does not pay or release a reservation.
billing.actionFailed: Action not confirmed. Check permissions, original usage and signing trust, then retry the same request.

states.remoteLedger: Compute Center submits evidence; status not synchronized

settlement.title: Settlements
settlement.draftFailed: Draft unavailable. Check both bill approvals, the original reservation and terminal record.
settlement.invalidSettlement: Invalid settlement, amounts or contract mismatch. Import the complete settlement for this contract.
settlement.approvalBoundary: Both institutions must approve the same settlement. Direct and attested cooperation apply accounting after countersigning; coordinated mode waits for VALID. This does not make a bank payment.
settlement.actionFailed: Action not confirmed. Check settlement permissions, the original bill, terminal record and signing trust, then retry the same request.

closing.title: Automatic approvals
closing.transportOff: No sending transport is configured on this site. Automatic processing is disabled.
closing.contractLimits: Unit: {{unit}} · Contract per-task limit: {{task}} · Contract budget: {{total}}
closing.invalid: Enter nonnegative integer amounts, 1–100000 approvals, a future expiry and at least one outcome. The cumulative limit must cover the per-record limit and stay within the contract budget.
closing.unknownGrant: The grant outcome is unknown. Refresh authority records before granting authority again.
closing.actionFailed: Action not confirmed. Check permissions and the original record, then retry.
closing.completedAt: Signatures completed {{time}}. See the original record for accounting and evidence.

effect.grant: Authority belongs to this institution and survives staff permission changes. Each party must authorize independently. Coordinated settlement waits for VALID before accounting; it does not make a bank payment.
effect.revoke: Stops new approvals under this authority. Existing signatures and signed originals remain. Revoke the old authority before granting a replacement.
effect.retry: Retry the original task. Existing bills, settlements, refunds and signatures remain unchanged. Resolve evidence or authorization issues first.

errors.DATA_WAITING: Waiting for usage, terminal or cancellation evidence
errors.POLICY_DENIED: Check both parties’ authority and limits before retrying
errors.AUTHORIZATION_EXPIRED: Authority expired; review or replace it
errors.DELIVERY_REJECTED: Peer rejected processing; check its authority and evidence
errors.OPERATION_CONFLICT: Original records conflict or a discount exists; review the original record
errors.UNTRUSTED_IDENTITY: Institution, certificate or signing trust unavailable

closing.preExecutionCancellation: Only permanently cancelled tasks that never started execution

adjustment.title: Adjustments
adjustment.draftFailed: Draft unavailable. Check the applied settlement, completed previous adjustment and charge limit.
adjustment.invalidAdjustment: Invalid adjustment or contract mismatch. Import the complete original for this contract.
adjustment.approvalBoundary: Approve the same original at both institutions. Increases reserve funds at local approval; accounting and decreases apply after countersigning. Signed holds do not expire automatically. No bank payment or refund is made.
adjustment.actionFailed: Action unconfirmed. Refresh and check the original adjustment ID, approval permission, predecessor and signing trust. Retry the same original.
adjustment.coordinatedBoundary: Both institutions sign the same original. Local accounting waits for VALID. No bank payment or refund is made.

refund.title: Refunds
refund.draftFailed: Draft unavailable. Check that cancellation is confirmed and no execution workflow was ever created.
refund.invalidRefund: Invalid refund or contract mismatch. Import the complete original for this contract.
refund.approvalBoundary: Both institutions must approve the same original. Countersigning returns the full cooperation reservation; asynchronous evidence does not delay the refund. This does not make a bank refund.
refund.actionFailed: Action not confirmed. Refresh and inspect the original refund, permissions and signing trust before retrying. Do not create another refund.
refund.coordinated: Use the original reservation release or terminal settlement for coordinated tasks.
refund.retryBoundary: Retry only the original refund evidence. No additional funds are returned.

logistics.title: Media transport
logistics.name: Name
logistics.invalid: Check required fields, capacity and evidence format.
logistics.uncertain: Write outcome unconfirmed. The form is preserved. Query the original record; retry sends the same request. For version conflicts, go back and refresh.
logistics.denied: Media transport permission is not granted in this organization.

delivery.title: Media delivery
delivery.denied: Asset read permission is not granted in this organization.
delivery.subject: Material purpose
delivery.invalid: Check required fields, IDs, expiry and the manifest file.
delivery.unconfirmed: Submission outcome is unconfirmed. The form is preserved. Query the original record first; retry sends the same request.
delivery.privateVerified: Files are verified in private quarantine. Task execution still requires publication and valid use authorization.

payment.title: Payments
payment.paidOnly: Payment receipts require a paid agreement.
payment.correctionBoundary: Enter the full corrected amount. Once both parties confirm, it replaces the previous amount and preserves the original receipt.
payment.approvalBoundary: Acknowledges an external payment only. It does not transfer money or change the bill, cooperation credit, or execution permission.
payment.retryBoundary: Retries evidence submission only. It does not transfer money or confirm the payment again.
payment.unknownWrite: Write outcome unconfirmed. Check the original receipt before creating another payment.
payment.unconfirmed: The original receipt is still unconfirmed. Check again later.
payment.draftFailed: Cannot prepare the receipt. Check the fields and bill status; for a correction, refresh the original receipt first.
payment.invalid: Receipt format, bill, or agreement does not match.
payment.actionFailed: The action failed. Check evidence configuration before retrying.
payment.approvalRejected: Approval rejected. Cancel to check fields, permission, and the original record, then prepare or import the receipt again.

dispute.title: Disputes
dispute.withdrawalRequired: Bilateral settlement requires permanent withdrawal of the previous execution commitment.
dispute.unsupported: This withdrawal settlement procedure supports direct and asynchronous cooperation.
dispute.invalidImport: The file is invalid or belongs to another case or contract.
dispute.financialNotReady: Financial originals are not reconciled. Finish the pending exchange or application first.
dispute.separateFinancialApproval: This approves the exact financial record separately from the settlement agreement.
dispute.financialApproved: Financial record approved locally; awaiting counterpart signature or application.
dispute.confirmation: The signed proposal is fixed for this case. Both parties must approve the same content.
dispute.financialConfirmation: Apply the reviewed financial terms using your separate financial approval authority.
dispute.withdrawConfirmation: This commitment cannot be executed again after the compute center confirms non-execution. Existing charges are preserved.
dispute.failed: The action was not confirmed. Check the current record and retry the same proposal.

errors.DATA_WAITING: Original records or counterpart approvals are still pending. Refresh after they are ready.
errors.OPERATION_CONFLICT: The case or financial head changed. Refresh and review the original proposal.
errors.POLICY_DENIED: The action is not authorized for this identity or case.
errors.UNTRUSTED_IDENTITY: Check the institution signing purposes and trust configuration.

dispute.openConfirmation: Opening a dispute pauses new financial approvals for this task while both institutions reconcile the records. It does not refund charges or cancel the job.
dispute.notReady: The case still has unresolved execution or financial records. Recover the original operation first.

arbitration.title: Arbitration decision
arbitration.readPermission: Reading a decision requires arbitration approval or execution permission.
arbitration.executionConfirmation: Approve this institution’s execution of the original decision. Additional charges are held first; financial execution requires the counterpart’s approval.
arbitration.coordinatedConfirmation: Authorize this institution’s execution of the original decision. Charges and case closure apply only after chain confirmation.
arbitration.retryConfirmation: Retry the existing attestation using its recovery record. This does not approve or apply the charge again.

tasks.title: Federation tasks
tasks.noPermission: Federation task access has not been granted.
tasks.preparePermission: Creating tasks also requires agreement and asset read access.
tasks.optionsFailed: Could not load prepared resources. Check agreement and asset read access, then refresh.
tasks.invalid: Check the selected snapshots, resources and maximum charge against the agreement.
tasks.confirmation: Submit this task to the selected institution under the execution agreement.
tasks.failed: The operation could not be completed. Refresh the record and try again.
tasks.unknown: The response is unknown. Retry the original request to recover its result.
tasks.cancelConfirmation: Request a permanent stop. Keep following this record until the execution site confirms it has stopped.
tasks.actionConfirmation: Continue with this task’s original record. This does not create a new computation.

assets.title: Federation assets
assets.tooLarge: Material must be at most 1 MiB. Choose a smaller file and retry.
assets.invalid: Invalid material or fields. Check the site, revision, digest and original format.
assets.readFailed: Could not read the file. Select it again.
assets.noPermission: You do not have permission to view federation assets.
assets.unknown: The response is unconfirmed. Keep this material and retry the original request.
assets.failed: The operation did not complete. Check permissions, asset status and content digests, then retry.
assets.detailFailed: Could not read or verify this material. Refresh to retry.

empty.material: No input snapshots or environment locks.

assets.revokeEffect: New tasks using this mapping will no longer resolve the asset. Revocation is permanent.
assets.importEffect: Materials and mappings resolve versions. They do not grant software licenses, data use or execution permissions.

automation.title: Automatic authorization
automation.unavailable: Both parties must sign a coordinated contract before granting authorization.
automation.grantEffect: Authorize this institution to sign within the selected scope and limits. Execution and financial approval remain separate.
automation.revokeEffect: Permanently stop new signatures under this authorization. Existing commitments and records remain in effect.
automation.invalid: Check the amount and task limits, selected outcomes, and future expiry within the contract period.
automation.uncertain: Authorization outcome unconfirmed. Refresh and inspect the saved policies before creating another; do not resubmit the grant.

market.title: Task market
market.noContract: No matching signed contract on this page. Configure one in Commercial contracts.
market.noPermission: Market access has not been granted.
market.disabled: The ledger market is not enabled on this platform.
market.publicWarning: Demand titles, descriptions and resource requirements are public to alliance members. Do not include prices, contract terms, personal information or research data.
market.claimWarning: Claiming reserves the market demand. Execution still requires the private reservation, budget authorization and a VALID ledger result.
market.confirmWarning: Confirm this request independently. Local acceptance and ledger confirmation are separate; neither proves that a job has run.
market.unknown: The result is unknown. Find the original operation or retry this exact request with the same identifier. Do not submit a replacement.
market.rejected: Submission failed. Refresh the current demand and permissions before trying again.
market.unavailable: The demand could not be read. Refresh to retry; a ledger outage does not mean the directory is empty.
market.operationUnavailable: The original operation could not be read. Refresh to retry; do not replace an unknown transaction.
market.invalid: Check the fields and choose a future expiry time.
market.noTransactions: No transaction has been prepared yet.
market.waitingRequest: Waiting for the original private request on this page. No replacement claim will be created.
market.contractUnavailable: The contract has expired or does not cover this demand’s duration and resources.

marketRequest.title: Market requests
marketRequest.noPolicy: No usable market publishing policy on this page. Configure one under Automation or check the next page.
marketRequest.invalid: Check resources, amount and validity. The execution deadline must fall within the contract and authorization periods.
marketRequest.disabled: The market request channel is disabled at this site. History remains available.
marketRequest.unknown: Submission outcome unknown. Continue to look up the original request and recover with the same ID and body.
marketRequest.rejected: The request could not be submitted. Check the contract and authorization, then resume the original request.
marketRequest.executionBoundary: Completion confirms market handoff. Reservation authorization, environment preparation and job execution have separate states.
marketRequest.confirmWarning: The public demand will appear in the market. Contract, amount and material references go privately to the designated partner. Automatic execution remains subject to both parties’ authorization.

governance.title: Arbitration & disclosure
governance.confirm: Sign on behalf of this organization. Both parties must approve before the terms take effect.
governance.unknown: The outcome is unconfirmed. Recover the original action with the same ID and terms.
governance.invalid: Check the required fields, authority and expiry.

evidence.title: Arbitration cases
evidence.registerUnknown: Registration is unconfirmed. Recover the original action.
evidence.closeConfirm: Closing prevents further evidence access and decisions. It does not settle the parties' accounts.
evidence.importConfirm: Fetch only fields approved by both parties. Current authorization is checked with each party.
evidence.readFailed: Evidence is unavailable or authorization has expired. Check authorization and retry.
evidence.ledgerFailed: Could not read the decision commitment.
evidence.review: Review party state and selected evidence
evidence.reviewFailed: Current evidence or party state is unavailable. Check authorization and retry.
evidence.draftFailed: Could not draft decision. Check evidence, amount and authority.
evidence.decisionConfirm: Review the original. Signing, ledger recording and execution by each party are tracked separately.

historyRecovery.title: Recover historical attestation
historyRecovery.effect: Both institutions acknowledge the preserved original under their current signing authority. This creates a separate historical receipt; it does not renew execution authority or change accounts.
historyRecovery.invalidImport: The approval file is invalid or refers to another original or contract.
historyRecovery.failed: Recovery was not confirmed. Check the original record, current signing trust and permissions, then retry the same recovery.

states.committed: Historical receipt confirmed under current bilateral approval

errors.DATA_WAITING: The original transaction or local application is unresolved. Recover the original operation first.
errors.POLICY_DENIED: This original is not eligible for historical recovery, or the required authority is missing.
errors.OPERATION_CONFLICT: The original or approved recovery differs. Refresh and compare the signed records.
errors.UNTRUSTED_IDENTITY: Check both institutions’ current recovery signing purposes and trust configuration.
errors.HISTORY_REAPPROVAL_REQUIRED: Import the counterpart’s current approval before resuming this historical receipt.

historyRecovery.reauthorizeEffect: Preserve the original text and prior signatures, then approve with current local authority. The counterpart must approve again. Transactions with an unknown result must be recovered first.

federation.refreshFailed: Refresh failed. Showing the previously loaded data.

clusters.profilesHelp: Configure approved templates, pinned software environments, and input/output mappings.
clusters.invalidJson: Execution mappings contain invalid JSON. Correct it and save again.
clusters.moreMembers: Search by name or email to find more members.
